<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,827)>I wonder if there are any Pokémon or humans still around
in this place... <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,668)>It’s exciting to think of the possibilities!

<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>Right then! <$cdef(27)>!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>Would you mind going ahead and scouting out the
area first?

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Ah, you’ve found a great vantage point,
<$cdef(27)>!
We
can
look
out
over
the
whole
area
from here!

<$voicel(1,5)>It looks like this was another town where people used to
live, but...<$voicel(1,4)>it’s pretty much in ruins now.
<$voicel(1,5)>And I’m not sure why—perhaps it’s the clouds?—but this
place sure is dark.

<$voicel(1,7)>At any rate, we’d better start out by finding a safe spot
where we can relax.
<$voicel(1,5)>Do you see a <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center</color> anywhere?
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)>Oh dear... It looks like the bridge is broken.
<$voicel(1,7)>I can’t make it across that gap...

<$voicel(1,3)>Do you think you can fix this bridge,
<$cdef(27)>?
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)>I can’t cross to the other side.

<$voicel(1,5)>You should be able to use something to connect this side
of the bridge to the other side.

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,801)>Phew! I made it safely to the other side—thanks to you,
of course!
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,27)><$facial(1,13)>Oh!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Look, <$cdef(27)>! There was a <$cdef(27)>Pokémon
Center
here too!

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Do you think this <$cdef(27)>PC still works properly, like the
other one?

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)>Why don’t you check out this <$cdef(27)>PC,
<$cdef(27)>?

*beep beep beep*
Accessing <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center.

... ... ...
*bzzz zzzt*
There is a problem with the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center <$cdef(27)>PC.
Please contact a nearby <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center staff member.
We apologize for the inconvenience.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,9)>Hmmm... This <$cdef(27)>PC </color>doesn’t seem to be working.

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)>It’s just a hunch, but I think the flooding here may be
the problem.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,17)>Human-made machines are awfully convenient, but they
don’t do well with water.<$motion(1,654)>

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)>So I think we should do something about all this water
before we try anything else.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Where in the world is the water coming from anyway?
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Where in the world is all this water coming from?

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)>If you block wherever it’s flowing from, that should
clear the water from this area, I think.
*beep beep beep*
The <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center</color> <$cdef(27)>PC</color> has started working again!
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,14)>Oho! Excellent job getting rid of that water!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Maybe now the<$cdef(27)> Pokémon Center</color> <$cdef(27)>PC</color> will work properly!
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Why don’t you check the <$cdef(27)>PC</color>, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>?
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,668)>Isn’t this thrilling?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oho! So the <$cdef(27)>PC</color>’s working now, is it?

Welcome to the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center!
Here, you can continue taking on <$cdef(27)>challenges to improve
the quality of your environment!
Each <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center offers its own original <$cdef(27)>challenges.
Please do your best to complete them!
<$voicel(1,3)>Do you think you can get items from this <$cdef(27)>PC </color>too?

The <$cdef(27)>Life Coins you get from completing <$cdef(27)>challenges can be
used at any Pokémon Center!
You can exchange them at this <$cdef(27)>PC or others for the items
of your choice!
We’ve added more to our lineup, so be sure to check
it out—and keep on living your best Poké Life!
<$voicel(1,7)>Oho! So we CAN get more useful items here!

<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,807)>Still, this <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center is in pretty sorry shape, just like
the last one...
<$voicel(1,5)>I daresay it would be a problem for any humans
who return.

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,827)>What say you, <$cdef(27)>? Shall we find
some
friends
around
here
as
well...
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)>and rebuild another <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center?<$motion(1,654)>

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)>Well, let’s see... I’d start by <$voicel(1,5)>creating <$cdef(27)>habitats to make it
easier for more Pokémon to come back.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>I’m sure the items you get from this <$cdef(27)>PC will help with that!

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>Oho! That’s the answer I hoped to hear!
<$voicel(1,7)>Your best bet is probably creating more <$cdef(27)>habitats to make
it easier for more Pokémon to return.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>I’m sure the items you get from this <$cdef(27)>PC will help with that!

<$voicel(1,5)>Then, once we’ve got enough Pokémon back here, we can
all work together <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,27)><$facial(1,4)>to rebuild this <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center!

<$voicel(1,5)>I think many humans and Pokémon must have lived
together in this town too.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>It would warm my heart to see it restored to its original
brightness.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, look! Is that a <$cdef(27)>Meowth </color>over there?

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)><$cdef(27)>, why don’t you go <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)>talk
to <$cdef(27)>Meowth?

*beep beep beep*
Accessing <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center.

<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,664)>First, let’s follow <$cdef(27)>Meowth</color>.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>It looks like they headed toward that shack!
<$voicel(1,7)>Oh! Looks like this <$cdef(27)>PC </color>is working!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>That’s great to hear! Believe it or not, I can’t swim. <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)>So
please make a nice big bridge that even I can cross!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)>You should be able to fix it by connecting the two broken
sides of the bridge with something.
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)><$facial(1,4)>This may surprise you, but I can’t swim, so I’m counting
on you!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>First things first—let’s find a <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center</color>.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$facial(1,9)>But golly, this place certainly is dark.

<$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)>And if anyone can make that happen, it’s
you, <$cdef(27)>!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)>Could that be what I think it is? <wait(0.9)>Come, follow me!

The <$cdef(27)>PC should be working... Bring <$cdef(27)><$cname;0(44)>
with you to check it out!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>You’ve fixed the bridge! Now THAT’s the
<$cdef(27)>
I’ve
come
to
know
and
appreciate!
<$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,664)>All right—time to cross that bridge!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,13)>One foot in front of the other... One, two, one, two...
Slow and steady so I don’t fall...

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)><$facial(1,1)>Sorry, <$cdef(27)>... Please wait until I’ve
reached
the
other side.
